description: Activate one fail-closed project -> agent -> sprint -> Pi run path without enabling continuous mode or dispatching the imported backlog broadly.
deviation_notes: Three Luna audits expanded the required production seams from agent provisioning to canonical project identity, scoped execution, atomic sprint assignment, fail-closed Pi readiness, restart recovery, receipt bounds, no-push task-branch safety, exact durable workload/sprint/Git evidence, and weak-test repair. All nonmutating implementation and verification gates are complete, including 1,717 Pivot tests, the definitive frontend rerun, three real-Chrome read-only journeys, incremental graph update, and final Doctor run. The track remains in progress because the credentialed one-task acceptance can mutate and locally commit the imported repository and is awaiting explicit user approval; residual graph/Doctor failures and the final registry closeout remain visible.
